Quantum 1.24.0 was certified on 2026-08-30. It pins **nucleus v1.21.0**, **quark v1.7.1** and **orbit v1.8.13**, with 6 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.23.0: nucleus goes from v1.20.1 to v1.21.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.7.0 to v1.7.1 (patch) and orbit goes from v1.8.10 to v1.8.13 (patch). 5 sibling modules change version.
